clips.title: The story
paras: At Winterhoof Water Well, Venture Company poisons the water beneath Mulgore's plains. Mull Thunderhorn crafts a totem to cleanse it.

Mull Thunderhorn crafts the Winterhoof Cleansing Totem in Bloodhoof Village. Venture Company goblins have tainted Mulgore's underground water with their operations. Mull imbues the carved wood with protective magic meant to wash away the foreign poisons. Carried past hostile goblin guards to Winterhoof Water Well, the totem channels a focused ritual that disperses the contamination. Pure drinking water returns for the plains' wandering herds and native tribes.
